grouping_method.description: Deterministic grouping from structured seed.kind, per-shard membership, related_paths, and bounded keyword/doc-path heuristics for doc_discovery; primary work group chosen by category precedence process_only > doc_hint > open_decision > doc_discovery > obligation_core. Seeds missing seed_id receive stable synthetic IDs derived from shard, line_in_shard, kind, and text hash.

final_gate.reason: Every per_shard seed row is assigned exactly one primary work group; no exclusions required.
